subject: EOT settlement: invoice split, payment waterfall, and VAT residency
messages:
From: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@quantix.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Quantix Billing <billing@quantix.ai>, Gideon Hall <gideon.hall@quantix.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:12:00 +0100
Subject: EOT billing & PO mapping — Quantix / Redwood

Hi Priya,

Thanks for running through the numbers on the call earlier. To close the account cleanly we need: a formal invoice split that maps to our internal POs (Quantix PO 5678 & 6112), text on the invoice line items to show the committed vs overage true‑up, and a VAT residency statement so our AP team can process the cross‑border payment.

Two practical constraints from our side:
- We can only accept one wire per PO (our Treasury requires a PO match to apply payment).
- For international settlement we need your bank routing screenshot and beneficiary name on the invoice.

I attached the POs. Can Redwood provide a waterfall that shows: committed credit, pro‑rated remaining credit, overage charges, and the final net due per PO? Also confirm whether Redwood will split into two invoices (one per PO) or provide a single invoice with a split schedule.

Best,
Amelia

[Attachment: Quantix_PO_5678.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: Quantix_PO_6112.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@quantix.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 17:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EOT billing & PO mapping — Quantix / Redwood

Amelia —

Thanks for the clarity and the POs. We can do either approach but want to avoid delay in your AP. Proposal:

Option A (recommended): two separate final invoices, one per PO. Each invoice will include the waterfall lines so your AP can apply the payment to PO 5678 or 6112 directly.

Option B: single invoice with an appendix schedule mapping net due to each PO (your AP would need to do a two‑way allocation).

To proceed we need:
1) Confirmation that Quantix will instruct Treasury to accept two incoming wires (one per PO) — if not, we will issue the single invoice option.
2) Bank routing snapshot for the receiving account to cross‑check beneficiary name (we need this for OFAC/AML).

Action: Marcus and Jonas, can you run the waterfall calc from the Final_TrueUp.xlsx I’m attaching and confirm the numbers (committed credit, pro‑rated unused credit, overage at list rates, and final taxes/VAT per EU reverse charge/residency)? I’ll draft two invoice PDFs once we confirm.

I’ll hold the invoices in Draft state and queue DocuSign links for signature once we lock routing.

— Priya
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Final_TrueUp.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EOT billing & PO mapping — Quantix / Redwood

Priya —

Quick sanity check after running the workbook:
- Committed credit applied: EUR 120,000 (PO 5678: EUR 72,000; PO 6112: EUR 48,000)
- Pro‑rated unused credit to return: EUR 6,400 (split per usage logs — see sheet 'credit_return')
- Overage charges (net): EUR 9,850 (pre‑VAT) — client used excess tokens in Apr/May when ramp ended
- VAT handling: Quantix has confirmed they are an EU VAT‑registered entity; we will not charge VAT if they provide a valid EU VAT ID and reverse‑charge wording. We need the VAT ID on the invoice or a short residency attestation.

Net due (after applying credits and excluding VAT): EUR 31,450 total. If we issue two invoices we will split per PO proportionally (see column F in the workbook).

I recommend issuing two invoices to match their Treasury constraints. Priya, I attached a candidate invoice naming convention and a bank routing stub we should include.

Marcus
Sr. Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Bank_Routing_Screenshot.png (image/png)]

From: Gideon Hall <gideon.hall@quantix.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@quantix.ai>, Quantix Billing <billing@quantix.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: EOT billing & PO mapping — Quantix / Redwood

Priya / Marcus —

Thanks — Quantix Treasury confirmed they can accept two separate wires and provided the beneficiary confirmation screen (attached). They also included the company VAT ID in the email header for your invoice.

Please issue two invoices with the following requirements before EOD Wednesday:
- Invoice PDF per PO, include PO number in the invoice header
- Include beneficiary full name exactly as shown on the routing screen (attached)
- Add the following VAT note exactly: "Reverse charge — EU customer VAT ID provided; no VAT charged by Redwood"
- Attach the Final_TrueUp.xlsx version with a 1‑line explanation of the waterfall in the DocuSign envelope

If you can confirm the two outgoing DocuSign links I’ll get them routed to our AP signatory.

Gideon
Head of Finance, Quantix AI
[Attachment: Bank_Routing_Screenshot.png (image/png)]
